Introduction
The digital sensor cables are especially designed for our popular IO Expansion shield and sensors. It connects most of our digital sensor to the IO board.
This price includes 10 pieces of cables.
Specification
Length:30cm (12 in)
Maximum voltage:<50V
Maximum current:<1000mA
One Servo Type connector with Signal, GND PWR.
One 3 Pin JST connector
Red: PWR, Black:GND; Green: Signal
